description: This file defines data structures and mock data generation for banner items on the home screen of an Android application. It includes a data class representing the banner item and an object providing mock banner data for development purposes.

classes.name: BannerItem
classes.description: A data class representing a 4:3 banner card item with an ID, title, and image URL.

classes.name: MockBannerData
classes.description: An object that provides mock data for banners, particularly a list of placeholder URLs and a generate function.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a list of mock BannerItem objects, cycling through placeholder image URLs.
